title: M1: Master Mariner Incapacity before Felixstowe Channel Window

event.narrative: Capt. Håkon Lindqvist incapacitated at Rotterdam Maasvlakte with acute infection before 05:00Z departure of MV Nordica (VOY-8813) crossing the English Channel to Felixstowe.

title: M2: Lock Congestion & Tidal Delay at River Elbe

event.narrative: Severe river fog and lock gate maintenance at Brunsbüttel delays MV Baltic transit by 5 hours, testing 14h STCW single-watch limit.

answer_key.recommendation: Deploy standby 2nd Mate at Cuxhaven to split watch into 6h-6h periods under STCW A-VIII/1.

title: M3: Port State Control (PSC) ECDIS Certification Audit

event.narrative: Paris MoU Port State Control announces comprehensive ECDIS JRC type-specific audit across all container vessels calling Rotterdam.
